cs.t: Over the years I've tried a leap, gesture, HON exposure, aeron, and embody... and after all of it still find I vastly prefer a $70 Ikea Millberget to all of them  https://www.ikea.com/us/en/catalog/products/00331707/  - the cheap material starts to flake after about 2 yrs of use so I'll just buy one every two years I guess. I guess the lesson is that every body is different and you gotta find what works for you
